title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Angry and Not Sin
caption:
Scripture doesn't say never be angry. It says be angry and do not sin. That's harder, because now you have to do something with it.

Name it, wait before you text, find what it's guarding, and fix it before dark.

Who do you owe a conversation tonight?

#faith #anger #scripture #godlymen #ephesians4
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
